themes.name: School Learning and Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school education, student learning support, teaching conditions, or services provided directly to students.

themes.name: Affordable Housing and Homes
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply or affordability, regulate rents, provide student housing, or improve the energy performance of homes.

themes.name: Sustainable Environment and Waste
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, expand recycling or composting, monitor environmental conditions, produce clean energy, or add urban greenery and gardens.

themes.name: Arts, Recreation and Shared Spaces
themes.rule: Proposals that expand cultural access, public events, parks, libraries, playgrounds, or recreational spaces for residents.

themes.name: Digital City Access and Information
themes.rule: Proposals that use digital tools, internet access, service channels, or public information systems to make city services and data easier to access.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, job seekers, local hiring, small businesses, coworking, business finance, or licensing.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public transit, cycling, pedestrian or traffic safety, and residents’ ability to travel around the city.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive, primary-care, specialist-care, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve street safety through policing or lighting, deploy surveillance, or shorten emergency response times.
